text:
jordan: FYI PR #4123 updates KMS key rotation + audithook wiring. This touches envelope format and HSM auth path — need security signoff before merge window tomorrow morning. Diff: https://git.company/pr/4123

maria: on it, thanks. Is there a migration step?

jordan: yes — small migration script in scripts/migrate_audit_ctx.sh, backwards compatible. I put a short note in the PR body.

sam: I'll run the HSM integration tests later today. Noted the auth change, will validate the token exchange.

maria: quick glance — i see a new field `audit_context_version`. Can you confirm consumers will ignore unknown fields?

jordan: they should. We added parsing to tolerate unknown keys: `AuditEnvelope::from_json(...).ignore_unknown=true`. See snippet in the PR.

sam: CI just failed on `integration-aws-hsm` with a timeout. Re-running now.

deploy-bot: ci/retry triggered for pr-4123 by sam — run #2 queued.

lee: a couple of ops notes: please add a runbook entry for key rotation + escalation steps and add a brief changelog line for Dedicated customers.

jordan: done — added runbook draft at docs/runbooks/kms-rotation.md and CHANGELOG.md entry.

maria: small nit inline about exponential backoff in auth retries, otherwise LGTM. Please address and ping.

jordan: fixed the retry logic (now cap at 10s) and pushed. Also added a unit test for the migration script.

sam: HSM tests passed on run #2. Verified token exchange and rotation sequence.

maria: approved ✅ — left one optional comment about log verbosity.

sam: approved ✅. I plan to merge in the 11:00 UTC merge window unless anyone objects.

jordan: thanks all. I'll cut the canary deploy and watch audit logs (`/services/audit/logs`). If anything spikes, i'll rollback.

lee: sounds good. remind ops on pager in the canary window.

jordan: will do, pinging #oncall at merge time.

maria: thanks — great to get this wrapped before the compliance checkpoint tomorrow.
